#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Economic Prospects Poster — A1 Portrait
Design Philosophy: Measured Force — Institutional authority where data becomes monument.
"""

import os
from reportlab.lib.units import mm
from reportlab.lib.colors import HexColor
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont
from reportlab.lib.utils import simpleSplit

# ─── Page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PAGE_W = 594 * mm  # 1683.78pt
PAGE_H = 841 * mm  # 2383.94pt

# ─── Margins ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML = 52 * mm
MR = 52 * mm
MT = 40 * mm
MB = 36 * mm
CW = PAGE_W - ML - MR  # Content width

# ─── Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = HexColor("#0B1D3A")
DARK_BLUE  = HexColor("#0F2B52")
MID_BLUE   = HexColor("#1A4480")
INST_BLUE  = HexColor("#1B5E9E")
TEAL       = HexColor("#0A7E8C")
DEEP_TEAL  = HexColor("#065A64")
LIGHT_TEAL = HexColor("#A8D5D8")
PALE_BLUE  = HexColor("#E3EDF7")
SKY_BLUE   = HexColor("#D6E8F5")
AMBER      = HexColor("#D4962E")
GOLD       = HexColor("#C8963E")
WARM_WHITE = HexColor("#F5F2EB")
OFF_WHITE  = HexColor("#EAE6DE")
COOL_GRAY  = HexColor("#8A9BAD")
MID_GRAY   = HexColor("#5C6F82")
DARK_GRAY  = HexColor("#3A4A5C")
TEXT_DARK   = HexColor("#1A2332")
TEXT_LIGHT  = HexColor("#F0EDE6")
RISK_BG    = HexColor("#0D2137")
RISK_RED   = HexColor("#C0392B")
RISK_AMBER = HexColor("#E67E22")
RISK_GOLD  = HexColor("#D4A03C")
DIVIDER    = HexColor("#C5CDD6")
CARD_BG    = HexColor("#143456")
CARD_BG2   = HexColor("#163A5C")

# ─── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FDIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

def reg(tag, fn):
    p = os.path.join(FDIR, fn)
    if os.path.exists(p):
        pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont(tag, p))

reg("BigB",    "BigShoulders-Bold.ttf")
reg("BigR",    "BigShoulders-Regular.ttf")
reg("WSB",     "WorkSans-Bold.ttf")
reg("WSR",     "WorkSans-Regular.ttf")
reg("WSI",     "WorkSans-Italic.ttf")
reg("WSBI",    "WorkSans-BoldItalic.ttf")
reg("GMB",     "GeistMono-Bold.ttf")
reg("GMR",     "GeistMono-Regular.ttf")
reg("JL",      "Jura-Light.ttf")
reg("JM",      "Jura-Medium.ttf")
reg("IBR",     "IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf")
reg("IBB",     "IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf")
reg("ISB",     "InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf")
reg("ISR",     "InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf")
reg("CrB",     "CrimsonPro-Bold.ttf")
reg("CrR",     "CrimsonPro-Regular.ttf")
reg("CrI",     "CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf")

# ─── Utilities ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def sw(font, size, text):
    return pdfmetrics.stringWidth(text, font, size)

def draw_rr(c, x, y, w, h, r, fill=None, stroke=None, sw_val=0.5):
    p = c.beginPath()
    p.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r)
    if fill: c.setFillColor(fill)
    if stroke: c.setStrokeColor(stroke); c.setLineWidth(sw_val)
    if fill and stroke: c.drawPath(p, 1, 1)
    elif fill: c.drawPath(p, 1, 0)
    elif stroke: c.drawPath(p, 0, 1)

def txt(c, text, x, y, maxw, font, sz, color, ld=None, align='left'):
    if not ld: ld = sz * 1.5
    c.setFont(font, sz); c.setFillColor(color)
    lines = simpleSplit(text, font, sz, maxw) if maxw > 0 else [text]
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        ty = y - i * ld
        if align == 'center':
            c.drawString(x + (maxw - sw(font, sz, line)) / 2, ty, line)
        elif align == 'right':
            c.drawString(x + maxw - sw(font, sz, line), ty, line)
        else:
            c.drawString(x, ty, line)
    return len(lines) * ld

def divider(c, x, y, w, color=DIVIDER, width=0.5):
    c.setStrokeColor(color); c.setLineWidth(width); c.line(x, y, x + w, y)

# ─── Y-tracker ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Y = PAGE_H - MT  # Start from top

# ─── Build ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
c = canvas.Canvas("/app/output/final_poster.pdf", pagesize=(PAGE_W, PAGE_H))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLE BAND
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

band_h = 200
c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.rect(0, Y - band_h, PAGE_W, band_h + MT, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Subtle geometric texture — thin vertical rules
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#112540"))
c.setLineWidth(0.3)
for vx in range(int(ML), int(PAGE_W - MR), 80):
    c.line(vx, Y - band_h + 10, vx, Y + MT - 10)

# Teal accent line
c.setStrokeColor(TEAL); c.setLineWidth(1.8)
c.line(ML, Y - band_h + 14, ML + 160, Y - band_h + 14)

# Title
c.setFont("BigB", 46); c.setFillColor(TEXT_LIGHT)
c.drawString(ML, Y - 58, "GLOBAL ECONOMIC PROSPECTS")

# Subtitle in amber
c.setFont("WSR", 18); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(ML, Y - 88, "Resilience Amid Uncertainty")

# Rule
c.setStrokeColor(AMBER); c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line(ML, Y - 98, ML + 360, Y - 98)

# Summary
c.setFont("WSR", 10.5); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#94A8BA"))
summary = ("The global economy has recovered strongly from the 2020 recession, but vulnerable "
           "economies lag behind as trade tensions and policy uncertainty cloud the outlook.")
txt(c, summary, ML, Y - 120, CW - 250, "WSR", 10.5, HexColor("#94A8BA"), ld=15)

# Right-aligned meta
c.setFont("JL", 11); c.setFillColor(COOL_GRAY)
c.drawRightString(PAGE_W - MR, Y - 55, "WORLD BANK GROUP")
c.setFont("JL", 9.5); c.setFillColor(MID_GRAY)
c.drawRightString(PAGE_W - MR, Y - 72, "June 2025")

Y -= band_h + 8

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2: A HISTORIC RECOVERY — BUT UNEVEN
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

sec2_h = 340
c.setFillColor(PALE_BLUE)
c.rect(ML - 14, Y - sec2_h, CW + 28, sec2_h + 6, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Header
c.setFont("ISB", 13); c.setFillColor(MID_BLUE)
c.drawString(ML, Y - 26, "A HISTORIC RECOVERY — BUT UNEVEN")
c.setStrokeColor(TEAL); c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(ML, Y - 33, ML + 320, Y - 33)

# ── Hero metric left: "6 DECADES" ──
hero_y = Y - 90
c.setFont("GMB", 72); c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.drawString(ML, hero_y, "6")

six_w = sw("GMB", 72, "6")
c.setFont("GMB", 26); c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.drawString(ML + six_w + 8, hero_y + 12, "DECADES")

c.setFont("JL", 11.5); c.setFillColor(DARK_GRAY)
c.drawString(ML, hero_y - 24, "Strongest recovery from the 2020 recession")

# Small amber bar accent
c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.rect(ML, hero_y - 42, 90, 2.5, fill=1, stroke=0)

# ── Hero metric right: "1.2 BILLION" ──
m2x = ML + 460
c.setFont("GMB", 72); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(m2x, hero_y, "1.2")

one2_w = sw("GMB", 72, "1.2")
c.setFont("GMB", 24); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(m2x + one2_w + 8, hero_y + 10, "BILLION")

c.setFont("JL", 11.5); c.setFillColor(DARK_GRAY)
c.drawString(m2x, hero_y - 24, "Youth entering working age in the next decade")

c.setFillColor(TEAL)
c.rect(m2x, hero_y - 42, 90, 2.5, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Body text
body_y = hero_y - 68
c.setFont("WSR", 10); c.setFillColor(TEXT_DARK)
body1 = ("The global economy has demonstrated notable resilience in the face of heightened trade tensions "
         "and policy uncertainty. Last year's faster-than-expected growth capped a recovery from the 2020 "
         "recession that is unmatched in six decades. However, this headline resilience masks a widening gap: "
         "vulnerable emerging market and developing economies (EMDEs) continue to lag significantly behind "
         "advanced economies and more robust peers.")
h1 = txt(c, body1, ML, body_y, CW, "WSR", 10, TEXT_DARK, ld=14)

body2 = ("In the current year, global growth is projected to edge downward, driven in part by firms scaling "
         "back inventory accumulation and the intensifying effects of tariffs. Growth could falter further if "
         "trade tensions escalate or financial market sentiment deteriorates sharply.")
txt(c, body2, ML, body_y - h1 - 8, CW, "WSR", 10, TEXT_DARK, ld=14)

Y -= sec2_h + 16

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3: RISKS TO THE OUTLOOK
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Economic Prospects Poster — A1 Portrait
Design Philosophy: Measured Force — Institutional authority where data becomes monument.
"""

import os
from reportlab.lib.units import mm
from reportlab.lib.colors import HexColor
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont
from reportlab.lib.utils import simpleSplit

# ─── Page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PAGE_W = 594 * mm  # 1683.78pt
PAGE_H = 841 * mm  # 2383.94pt

# ─── Margins ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML = 52 * mm
MR = 52 * mm
MT = 40 * mm
MB = 36 * mm
CW = PAGE_W - ML - MR  # Content width

# ─── Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = HexColor("#0B1D3A")
DARK_BLUE  = HexColor("#0F2B52")
MID_BLUE   = HexColor("#1A4480")
INST_BLUE  = HexColor("#1B5E9E")
TEAL       = HexColor("#0A7E8C")
DEEP_TEAL  = HexColor("#065A64")
LIGHT_TEAL = HexColor("#A8D5D8")
PALE_BLUE  = HexColor("#E3EDF7")
SKY_BLUE   = HexColor("#D6E8F5")
AMBER      = HexColor("#D4962E")
GOLD       = HexColor("#C8963E")
WARM_WHITE = HexColor("#F5F2EB")
OFF_WHITE  = HexColor("#EAE6DE")
COOL_GRAY  = HexColor("#8A9BAD")
MID_GRAY   = HexColor("#5C6F82")
DARK_GRAY  = HexColor("#3A4A5C")
TEXT_DARK   = HexColor("#1A2332")
TEXT_LIGHT  = HexColor("#F0EDE6")
RISK_BG    = HexColor("#0D2137")
RISK_RED   = HexColor("#C0392B")
RISK_AMBER = HexColor("#E67E22")
RISK_GOLD  = HexColor("#D4A03C")
DIVIDER    = HexColor("#C5CDD6")
CARD_BG    = HexColor("#143456")
CARD_BG2   = HexColor("#163A5C")

# ─── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FDIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

def reg(tag, fn):
    p = os.path.join(FDIR, fn)
    if os.path.exists(p):
        pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont(tag, p))

reg("BigB",    "BigShoulders-Bold.ttf")
reg("BigR",    "BigShoulders-Regular.ttf")
reg("WSB",     "WorkSans-Bold.ttf")
reg("WSR",     "WorkSans-Regular.ttf")
reg("WSI",     "WorkSans-Italic.ttf")
reg("WSBI",    "WorkSans-BoldItalic.ttf")
reg("GMB",     "GeistMono-Bold.ttf")
reg("GMR",     "GeistMono-Regular.ttf")
reg("JL",      "Jura-Light.ttf")
reg("JM",      "Jura-Medium.ttf")
reg("IBR",     "IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf")
reg("IBB",     "IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf")
reg("ISB",     "InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf")
reg("ISR",     "InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf")
reg("CrB",     "CrimsonPro-Bold.ttf")
reg("CrR",     "CrimsonPro-Regular.ttf")
reg("CrI",     "CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf")

# ─── Utilities ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def sw(font, size, text):
    return pdfmetrics.stringWidth(text, font, size)

def draw_rr(c, x, y, w, h, r, fill=None, stroke=None, sw_val=0.5):
    p = c.beginPath()
    p.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r)
    if fill: c.setFillColor(fill)
    if stroke: c.setStrokeColor(stroke); c.setLineWidth(sw_val)
    if fill and stroke: c.drawPath(p, 1, 1)
    elif fill: c.drawPath(p, 1, 0)
    elif stroke: c.drawPath(p, 0, 1)

def txt(c, text, x, y, maxw, font, sz, color, ld=None, align='left'):
    if not ld: ld = sz * 1.5
    c.setFont(font, sz); c.setFillColor(color)
    lines = simpleSplit(text, font, sz, maxw) if maxw > 0 else [text]
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        ty = y - i * ld
        if align == 'center':
            c.drawString(x + (maxw - sw(font, sz, line)) / 2, ty, line)
        elif align == 'right':
            c.drawString(x + maxw - sw(font, sz, line), ty, line)
        else:
            c.drawString(x, ty, line)
    return len(lines) * ld

def divider(c, x, y, w, color=DIVIDER, width=0.5):
    c.setStrokeColor(color); c.setLineWidth(width); c.line(x, y, x + w, y)

# ─── Y-tracker ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Y = PAGE_H - MT  # Start from top

# ─── Build ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
c = canvas.Canvas("/app/output/final_poster.pdf", pagesize=(PAGE_W, PAGE_H))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLE BAND
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

band_h = 200
c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.rect(0, Y - band_h, PAGE_W, band_h + MT, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Subtle geometric texture — thin vertical rules
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#112540"))
c.setLineWidth(0.3)
for vx in range(int(ML), int(PAGE_W - MR), 80):
    c.line(vx, Y - band_h + 10, vx, Y + MT - 10)

# Teal accent line
c.setStrokeColor(TEAL); c.setLineWidth(1.8)
c.line(ML, Y - band_h + 14, ML + 160, Y - band_h + 14)

# Title
c.setFont("BigB", 46); c.setFillColor(TEXT_LIGHT)
c.drawString(ML, Y - 58, "GLOBAL ECONOMIC PROSPECTS")

# Subtitle in amber
c.setFont("WSR", 18); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(ML, Y - 88, "Resilience Amid Uncertainty")

# Rule
c.setStrokeColor(AMBER); c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line(ML, Y - 98, ML + 360, Y - 98)

# Summary
c.setFont("WSR", 10.5); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#94A8BA"))
summary = ("The global economy has recovered strongly from the 2020 recession, but vulnerable "
           "economies lag behind as trade tensions and policy uncertainty cloud the outlook.")
txt(c, summary, ML, Y - 120, CW - 250, "WSR", 10.5, HexColor("#94A8BA"), ld=15)

# Right-aligned meta
c.setFont("JL", 11); c.setFillColor(COOL_GRAY)
c.drawRightString(PAGE_W - MR, Y - 55, "WORLD BANK GROUP")
c.setFont("JL", 9.5); c.setFillColor(MID_GRAY)
c.drawRightString(PAGE_W - MR, Y - 72, "June 2025")

Y -= band_h + 8

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2: A HISTORIC RECOVERY — BUT UNEVEN
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

sec2_h = 340
c.setFillColor(PALE_BLUE)
c.rect(ML - 14, Y - sec2_h, CW + 28, sec2_h + 6, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Header
c.setFont("ISB", 13); c.setFillColor(MID_BLUE)
c.drawString(ML, Y - 26, "A HISTORIC RECOVERY — BUT UNEVEN")
c.setStrokeColor(TEAL); c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(ML, Y - 33, ML + 320, Y - 33)

# ── Hero metric left: "6 DECADES" ──
hero_y = Y - 90
c.setFont("GMB", 72); c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.drawString(ML, hero_y, "6")

six_w = sw("GMB", 72, "6")
c.setFont("GMB", 26); c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.drawString(ML + six_w + 8, hero_y + 12, "DECADES")

c.setFont("JL", 11.5); c.setFillColor(DARK_GRAY)
c.drawString(ML, hero_y - 24, "Strongest recovery from the 2020 recession")

# Small amber bar accent
c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.rect(ML, hero_y - 42, 90, 2.5, fill=1, stroke=0)

# ── Hero metric right: "1.2 BILLION" ──
m2x = ML + 460
c.setFont("GMB", 72); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(m2x, hero_y, "1.2")

one2_w = sw("GMB", 72, "1.2")
c.setFont("GMB", 24); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(m2x + one2_w + 8, hero_y + 10, "BILLION")

c.setFont("JL", 11.5); c.setFillColor(DARK_GRAY)
c.drawString(m2x, hero_y - 24, "Youth entering working age in the next decade")

c.setFillColor(TEAL)
c.rect(m2x, hero_y - 42, 90, 2.5, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Body text
body_y = hero_y - 68
c.setFont("WSR", 10); c.setFillColor(TEXT_DARK)
body1 = ("The global economy has demonstrated notable resilience in the face of heightened trade tensions "
         "and policy uncertainty. Last year's faster-than-expected growth capped a recovery from the 2020 "
         "recession that is unmatched in six decades. However, this headline resilience masks a widening gap: "
         "vulnerable emerging market and developing economies (EMDEs) continue to lag significantly behind "
         "advanced economies and more robust peers.")
h1 = txt(c, body1, ML, body_y, CW, "WSR", 10, TEXT_DARK, ld=14)

body2 = ("In the current year, global growth is projected to edge downward, driven in part by firms scaling "
         "back inventory accumulation and the intensifying effects of tariffs. Growth could falter further if "
         "trade tensions escalate or financial market sentiment deteriorates sharply.")
txt(c, body2, ML, body_y - h1 - 8, CW, "WSR", 10, TEXT_DARK, ld=14)

Y -= sec2_h + 16

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3: RISKS TO THE OUTLOOK
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

sec3_h = 410
c.setFillColor(RISK_BG)
c.rect(0, Y - sec3_h, PAGE_W, sec3_h + 6, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Subtle grid texture
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#132A42")); c.setLineWidth(0.2)
for gy in range(int(Y - sec3_h), int(Y + 6), 60):
    c.line(0, gy, PAGE_W, gy)

# Header
c.setFont("ISB", 13); c.setFillColor(RISK_AMBER)
c.drawString(ML, Y - 26, "RISKS TO THE OUTLOOK")
c.setStrokeColor(RISK_AMBER); c.setLineWidth(1.2)
c.line(ML, Y - 34, ML + 230, Y - 34)

# Risk cards — 2×2 grid
col_w = (CW - 30) / 2
col1_x = ML
col2_x = ML + col_w + 30

risks = [
    ("01", "TRADE TENSIONS", "Escalation of tariffs and retaliatory measures could disrupt supply chains and dampen investment across advanced and developing economies.", RISK_AMBER),
    ("02", "FINANCIAL VOLATILITY", "A deterioration in sentiment could tighten financing conditions, especially for EMDEs dependent on external capital flows.", RISK_AMBER),
    ("03", "INVENTORY CORRECTION", "Firms that front-loaded purchases are now drawing down stocks, reducing near-term demand and production signals.", RISK_GOLD),
    ("04", "CLIMATE SHOCKS", "Extreme weather events continue to threaten agricultural output and infrastructure in vulnerable regions.", RISK_GOLD),
]

card_h = 120
card_gap_v = 14
risk_top = Y - 56

for i, (num, title, desc, accent) in enumerate(risks):
    cx = col1_x if i % 2 == 0 else col2_x
    row = i // 2
    cy = risk_top - row * (card_h + card_gap_v) - card_h

    # Card background
    draw_rr(c, cx, cy, col_w, card_h, 5, fill=HexColor("#142E48"))

    # Number badge
    draw_rr(c, cx + 12, cy + card_h - 30, 28, 20, 3, fill=accent)
    c.setFont("GMB", 10); c.setFillColor(RISK_BG)
    c.drawString(cx + 18, cy + card_h - 26, num)

    # Title
    c.setFont("ISB", 11); c.setFillColor(accent)
    c.drawString(cx + 50, cy + card_h - 27, title)

    # Description
    txt(c, desc, cx + 14, cy + card_h - 50, col_w - 30, "WSR", 9, HexColor("#A0B4C8"), ld=13)

# Tariff callout bar at bottom
tariff_y = risk_top - 2 * (card_h + card_gap_v) - 60
tw = CW * 0.72
tx = ML + (CW - tw) / 2
draw_rr(c, tx, tariff_y - 40, tw, 46, 4, fill=HexColor("#122840"), stroke=RISK_AMBER, sw_val=1.2)
c.setFont("JM", 10); c.setFillColor(RISK_AMBER)
tariff_str = "TARIFF EFFECTS  ·  Escalating trade barriers could reduce global GDP by up to 0.5% in the near term"
txt(c, tariff_str, tx + 20, tariff_y - 18, tw - 40, "JM", 10, RISK_AMBER, ld=14, align='center')

Y -= sec3_h + 16

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 4: POLICY ACTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

sec4_h = 280
c.setFillColor(WARM_WHITE)
c.rect(ML - 14, Y - sec4_h, CW + 28, sec4_h + 6, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Header
c.setFont("ISB", 13); c.setFillColor(MID_BLUE)
c.drawString(ML, Y - 26, "POLICY ACTIONS FOR SUSTAINED GROWTH")
c.setStrokeColor(TEAL); c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(ML, Y - 33, ML + 350, Y - 33)

# Table header
th_y = Y - 50
c.setFont("JL", 9); c.setFillColor(COOL_GRAY)
c.drawString(ML, th_y, "REFORM AREA")
c.drawString(ML + 160, th_y, "GLOBAL ACTION")
c.drawString(ML + 540, th_y, "DOMESTIC ACTION")
divider(c, ML, th_y - 5, CW, DIVIDER, 0.4)

policies = [
    ("Trade",     "Improve the multilateral trade environment",       "Diversify trade partners and products"),
    ("Finance",   "Ease external financing constraints for EMDEs",   "Strengthen macroeconomic policy frameworks"),
    ("Climate",   "Scale up climate risk mitigation & adaptation",    "Invest in resilient infrastructure"),
    ("Investment","Catalyze private capital flows",                   "Remove structural bottlenecks to business entry"),
    ("Jobs",      "Support cross-border labor mobility",              "Enhance skills development & labor market flexibility"),
]

row_h = 38
for i, (area, gact, dact) in enumerate(policies):
    ry = th_y - 22 - i * row_h
    # Dot
    c.setFillColor(TEAL); c.circle(ML + 4, ry + 4, 2.5, fill=1, stroke=0)
    # Area
    c.setFont("ISB", 9.5); c.setFillColor(DEEP_TEAL)
    c.drawString(ML + 14, ry, area.upper())
    # Global
    c.setFont("WSR", 9); c.setFillColor(TEXT_DARK)
    txt(c, gact, ML + 160, ry, 360, "WSR", 9, TEXT_DARK, ld=12)
    # Domestic
    txt(c, dact, ML + 540, ry, 400, "WSR", 9, TEXT_DARK, ld=12)
    if i < 4:
        divider(c, ML, ry - 12, CW, HexColor("#E0E0E0"), 0.3)

Y -= sec4_h + 16

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 5: WORLD BANK 2030 STRATEGIC PRIORITIES (Visual centerpiece)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

sec5_h = 660
c.setFillColor(DARK_BLUE)
c.rect(0, Y - sec5_h, PAGE_W, sec5_h + 6, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Subtle diagonal pattern
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#122B48")); c.setLineWidth(0.15)
for dx in range(-int(PAGE_H), int(PAGE_W + PAGE_H), 120):
    c.line(dx, Y - sec5_h, dx + sec5_h, Y)

# Header
c.setFont("ISB", 13); c.setFillColor(TEXT_LIGHT)
c.drawString(ML, Y - 26, "WORLD BANK 2030 STRATEGIC PRIORITIES")
c.setStrokeColor(AMBER); c.setLineWidth(1.2)
c.line(ML, Y - 34, ML + 360, Y - 34)

c.setFont("JL", 11); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#7A9CB8"))
c.drawString(ML, Y - 50, "Flagship initiatives driving inclusive growth and job creation")

# ── Metric Cards — Row 1: 3 cards ──
card_gap = 18
cw3 = (CW - 2 * card_gap) / 3
ch1 = 240

priorities = [
    ("1.5B",   "people",  "Health Services",  "Deliver quality, affordable\nhealth services",                AMBER, TEAL),
    ("300M",   "people",  "Mission 300",      "Electricity access in\nSub-Saharan Africa",                   AMBER, TEAL),
    ("300M",   "farmers", "AgriConnect",      "Farmers up the agricultural\nvalue chain",                     AMBER, TEAL),
    ("80M",    "women",   "Capital Support",  "Women & women-led businesses\naccess to capital",             AMBER, TEAL),
    ("1B+",    "people",  "Water Forward",    "Water security; 400M WBG\ncommitment",                         AMBER, TEAL),
]

row1_top = Y - 72

for i in range(3):
    cx = ML + i * (cw3 + card_gap)
    cy = row1_top - ch1
    val, unit, title, desc, vc, ac = priorities[i]

    # Card
    draw_rr(c, cx, cy, cw3, ch1, 6, fill=CARD_BG)

    # Accent top bar
    c.setFillColor(ac)
    c.rect(cx + 12, cy + ch1 - 4, cw3 - 24, 3, fill=1, stroke=0)

    # Large number
    c.setFont("GMB", 56); c.setFillColor(vc)
    c.drawString(cx + 18, cy + ch1 - 68, val)

    # Unit
    c.setFont("JL", 13); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#7A9CB8"))
    c.drawString(cx + 18, cy + ch1 - 88, unit)

    # Divider in card
    divider(c, cx + 18, cy + ch1 - 100, cw3 - 36, HexColor("#1E4A6E"), 0.5)

    # Title
    c.setFont("ISB", 12); c.setFillColor(TEXT_LIGHT)
    c.drawString(cx + 18, cy + ch1 - 120, title)

    # Description
    desc_lines = desc.split('\n')
    c.setFont("WSR", 9); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#8AA8C2"))
    for j, dl in enumerate(desc_lines):
        c.drawString(cx + 18, cy + ch1 - 140 - j * 14, dl)

# ── Row 2: 2 wider cards ──
cw2 = (CW - card_gap) / 2
ch2 = 200
row2_top = row1_top - ch1 - 20

for i in range(2):
    cx = ML + i * (cw2 + card_gap)
    cy = row2_top - ch2
    val, unit, title, desc, vc, ac = priorities[3 + i]

    draw_rr(c, cx, cy, cw2, ch2, 6, fill=CARD_BG)

    c.setFillColor(ac)
    c.rect(cx + 12, cy + ch2 - 4, cw2 - 24, 3, fill=1, stroke=0)

    c.setFont("GMB", 56); c.setFillColor(vc)
    c.drawString(cx + 18, cy + ch2 - 68, val)

    c.setFont("JL", 13); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#7A9CB8"))
    c.drawString(cx + 18, cy + ch2 - 88, unit)

    divider(c, cx + 18, cy + ch2 - 100, cw2 - 36, HexColor("#1E4A6E"), 0.5)

    c.setFont("ISB", 12); c.setFillColor(TEXT_LIGHT)
    c.drawString(cx + 18, cy + ch2 - 120, title)

    desc_lines = desc.split('\n')
    c.setFont("WSR", 9); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#8AA8C2"))
    for j, dl in enumerate(desc_lines):
        c.drawString(cx + 18, cy + ch2 - 140 - j * 14, dl)

# ── Connecting decorative element ──
# Subtle amber line connecting the two rows
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#2A5070")); c.setLineWidth(0.5)
c.line(ML + cw3 / 2, row1_top - ch1 - 2, ML + cw3 / 2, row2_top + 4)
c.line(ML + cw3 + card_gap + cw3 / 2, row1_top - ch1 - 2, ML + cw3 + card_gap + cw3 / 2, row2_top + 4)
c.line(ML + 2 * (cw3 + card_gap) + cw3 / 2, row1_top - ch1 - 2, ML + 2 * (cw3 + card_gap) + cw3 / 2, row2_top + 4)

Y -= sec5_h + 16

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 6: KEY RESEARCH THEMES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

sec6_h = 180
c.setFillColor(WARM_WHITE)
c.rect(ML - 14, Y - sec6_h, CW + 28, sec6_h + 6, fill=1, stroke=0)

c.setFont("ISB", 13); c.setFillColor(MID_BLUE)
c.drawString(ML, Y - 26, "KEY RESEARCH THEMES IN RECENT ISSUES")
c.setStrokeColor(TEAL); c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(ML, Y - 33, ML + 380, Y - 33)

themes = [
    ("Fiscal Policy",        "Fiscal rules (Jan 2026)\nSmall states (Jun 2024)"),
    ("Trade & Supply",       "High trade costs (Jun 2021)\nCOVID-19 value chains (Jun 2020)"),
    ("Commodity Markets",    "Price cycles (Jan 2022)\nEnergy implications (Jun 2022)"),
    ("Financial Spillovers", "Rising U.S. rates (Jun 2023)\nRapid debt buildup (Jan 2020)"),
    ("Pandemic Economics",   "Income inequality (Jan 2022)\nRegional macro (Jun 2020)"),
]

tw5 = (CW - 4 * 20) / 5
theme_y = Y - 52

for i, (title, examples) in enumerate(themes):
    tx = ML + i * (tw5 + 20)

    # Teal dot
    c.setFillColor(TEAL); c.circle(tx + 4, theme_y + 3, 3, fill=1, stroke=0)

    # Title
    c.setFont("ISB", 9.5); c.setFillColor(NAVY)
    c.drawString(tx + 14, theme_y, title)

    # Examples
    c.setFont("WSR", 8); c.setFillColor(MID_GRAY)
    for j, line in enumerate(examples.split('\n')):
        c.drawString(tx + 14, theme_y - 18 - j * 12, line)

    # Vertical divider
    if i < 4:
        c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#D0D6DC")); c.setLineWidth(0.3)
        c.line(tx + tw5 + 10, theme_y + 10, tx + tw5 + 10, theme_y - 45)

Y -= sec6_h + 12

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FOOTER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

footer_h = 48
c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.rect(0, Y - footer_h, PAGE_W, footer_h + MB, fill=1, stroke=0)

c.setFont("JL", 8); c.setFillColor(COOL_GRAY)
c.drawString(ML, Y - 18, "Source: World Bank Group — Global Economic Prospects, June 2025")
c.drawRightString(PAGE_W - MR, Y - 18, "World Bank Group  ·  2025")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Economic Prospects Poster — A1 Portrait
Design Philosophy: Measured Force
Refined Pass 2 — Museum-quality craftsmanship
"""

import os
from reportlab.lib.units import mm
from reportlab.lib.colors import HexColor, Color
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont
from reportlab.lib.utils import simpleSplit

# ─── Page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PW = 594 * mm   # 1683.78pt
PH = 841 * mm   # 2383.94pt

# ─── Grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML  = 50 * mm
MR  = 50 * mm
CW  = PW - ML - MR   # content width
COL = 4               # 4-column grid
GUT = 16               # gutter between columns
COL_W = (CW - (COL - 1) * GUT) / COL

# ─── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = HexColor("#0A1C32")
DARK_BLUE  = HexColor("#0E2640")
MID_BLUE   = HexColor("#184880")
INST_BLUE  = HexColor("#1A5CA0")
TEAL       = HexColor("#0B7E8C")
DEEP_TEAL  = HexColor("#076068")
PALE_BLUE  = HexColor("#E1EBF5")
SKY        = HexColor("#D4E4F2")
AMBER      = HexColor("#CC8F1F")
BRIGHT_AMB = HexColor("#D9A42A")
WARM_W     = HexColor("#F4F1E9")
COOL_G     = HexColor("#8A9BAD")
MID_G      = HexColor("#5C6F82")
DARK_G     = HexColor("#3A4A5C")
TX_DK      = HexColor("#182430")
TX_LT      = HexColor("#EEEAE2")
R_BG       = HexColor("#0C1E34")
R_AMB      = HexColor("#D4801E")
R_GLD      = HexColor("#BF9530")
CARD       = HexColor("#12304C")
CARD2      = HexColor("#153858")
DIV        = HexColor("#C0C8D2")

# ─── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
def R(t, f):
    p = os.path.join(FD, f)
    if os.path.exists(p): pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont(t, p))

R("BB","BigShoulders-Bold.ttf");    R("BR","BigShoulders-Regular.ttf")
R("WB","WorkSans-Bold.ttf");       R("WR","WorkSans-Regular.ttf")
R("WI","WorkSans-Italic.ttf");     R("WBI","WorkSans-BoldItalic.ttf")
R("GB","GeistMono-Bold.ttf");      R("GR","GeistMono-Regular.ttf")
R("JL","Jura-Light.ttf");          R("JM","Jura-Medium.ttf")
R("SR","IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf"); R("SB","IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf")
R("IB","InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf");  R("IR","InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf")
R("CB","CrimsonPro-Bold.ttf");      R("CR","CrimsonPro-Regular.ttf")
R("CI","CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf")
R("OB","Outfit-Bold.ttf");          R("OR","Outfit-Regular.ttf")
R("JB","JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf");   R("JR","JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf")

# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def W(f, s, t): return pdfmetrics.stringWidth(t, f, s)

def rr(c, x, y, w, h, r, fill=None, stroke=None, sw=0.5):
    p = c.beginPath(); p.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r)
    if fill: c.setFillColor(fill)
    if stroke: c.setStrokeColor(stroke); c.setLineWidth(sw)
    if fill and stroke: c.drawPath(p, 1, 1)
    elif fill: c.drawPath(p, 1, 0)
    elif stroke: c.drawPath(p, 0, 1)

def T(c, t, x, y, mw, f, s, col, ld=None, al='left'):
    """Text block. Returns total height."""
    if not ld: ld = s * 1.48
    c.setFont(f, s); c.setFillColor(col)
    lines = simpleSplit(t, f, s, mw) if mw > 0 else [t]
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        ty = y - i * ld
        if al == 'center':
            c.drawString(x + (mw - W(f, s, ln)) / 2, ty, ln)
        elif al == 'right':
            c.drawString(x + mw - W(f, s, ln), ty, ln)
        else:
            c.drawString(x, ty, ln)
    return len(lines) * ld

def dv(c, x, y, w, col=DIV, sw=0.4):
    c.setStrokeColor(col); c.setLineWidth(sw); c.line(x, y, x + w, y)

def accent_bar(c, x, y, w, h, col):
    c.setFillColor(col); c.rect(x, y, w, h, fill=1, stroke=0)

# ─── Canvas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
c = canvas.Canvas("/app/output/final_poster.pdf", pagesize=(PW, PH))
y = PH - 34 * mm   # top cursor

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  I. TITLE BAND
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tb_h = 210
c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.rect(0, y - tb_h, PW, tb_h + 34 * mm, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Subtle vertical grid lines in title area
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#0F2438")); c.setLineWidth(0.25)
for vx in range(int(ML), int(PW - MR), 80):
    c.line(vx, y - tb_h + 6, vx, y + 34 * mm - 6)

# Amber accent bar — left edge
accent_bar(c, ML, y - tb_h + 12, 3, 28, AMBER)

# Title
c.setFont("BB", 48); c.setFillColor(TX_LT)
c.drawString(ML + 14, y - 52, "GLOBAL ECONOMIC PROSPECTS")

# Subtitle
c.setFont("WR", 17); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(ML + 14, y - 80, "Resilience Amid Uncertainty")

# Rule
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#8A6A1A")); c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(ML + 14, y - 90, ML + 380, y - 90)

# Summary
c.setFont("WR", 10); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#8CA0B4"))
T(c, "The global economy has recovered strongly from the 2020 recession, but vulnerable "
   "economies lag behind as trade tensions and policy uncertainty cloud the outlook.",
   ML + 14, y - 110, CW - 280, "WR", 10, HexColor("#8CA0B4"), ld=14)

# Right meta
c.setFont("JM", 10.5); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#6A8298"))
c.drawRightString(PW - MR, y - 48, "WORLD BANK GROUP")
c.setFont("JL", 9); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#506878"))
c.drawRightString(PW - MR, y - 64, "Global Economic Prospects  ·  June 2025")

y -= tb_h + 6

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  II. A HISTORIC RECOVERY — BUT UNEVEN
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

s2_h = 355
c.setFillColor(PALE_BLUE)
c.rect(ML - 12, y - s2_h, CW + 24, s2_h + 4, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Section header
c.setFont("IB", 12.5); c.setFillColor(MID_BLUE)
c.drawString(ML, y - 24, "A HISTORIC RECOVERY — BUT UNEVEN")
c.setStrokeColor(TEAL); c.setLineWidth(0.8)
c.line(ML, y - 30, ML + 310, y - 30)

# ── Left hero: "6 DECADES" ──
hy = y - 88
c.setFont("GB", 80); c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.drawString(ML, hy, "6")
six_w = W("GB", 80, "6")
c.setFont("GB", 26); c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.drawString(ML + six_w + 8, hy + 14, "DECADES")

c.setFont("JL", 11); c.setFillColor(DARK_G)
c.drawString(ML, hy - 22, "Strongest recovery from the 2020 recession")

accent_bar(c, ML, hy - 38, 80, 2, AMBER)

# ── Right hero: "1.2 BILLION" ──
m2x = ML + 440
c.setFont("GB", 80); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(m2x, hy, "1.2")
w12 = W("GB", 80, "1.2")
c.setFont("GB", 24); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(m2x + w12 + 8, hy + 12, "BILLION")

c.setFont("JL", 11); c.setFillColor(DARK_G)
c.drawString(m2x, hy - 22, "Youth entering working age in the next decade")

accent_bar(c, m2x, hy - 38, 80, 2, TEAL)

# ── Body ──
by = hy - 62
c.setFont("WR", 9.5); c.setFillColor(TX_DK)
b1 = ("The global economy has demonstrated notable resilience in the face of heightened trade tensions "
      "and policy uncertainty. Last year's faster-than-expected growth capped a recovery from the 2020 "
      "recession that is unmatched in six decades. However, this headline resilience masks a widening gap: "
      "vulnerable emerging market and developing economies (EMDEs) continue to lag significantly behind "
      "advanced economies and more robust peers.")
h1 = T(c, b1, ML, by, CW, "WR", 9.5, TX_DK, ld=13.5)

b2 = ("In the current year, global growth is projected to edge downward, driven in part by firms scaling "
      "back inventory accumulation and the intensifying effects of tariffs. Growth could falter further if "
      "trade tensions escalate or financial market sentiment deteriorates sharply.")
T(c, b2, ML, by - h1 - 6, CW, "WR", 9.5, TX_DK, ld=13.5)

y -= s2_h + 10

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  III. RISKS TO THE OUTLOOK
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

s3_h = 420
c.setFillColor(R_BG)
c.rect(0, y - s3_h, PW, s3_h + 4, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Subtle horizontal grid
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#112840")); c.setLineWidth(0.15)
for gy in range(int(y - s3_h), int(y + 4), 48):
    c.line(0, gy, PW, gy)

# Header with warning icon
c.setFont("IB", 12.5); c.setFillColor(R_AMB)
c.drawString(ML, y - 24, "RISKS TO THE OUTLOOK")
c.setStrokeColor(R_AMB); c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(ML, y - 31, ML + 220, y - 31)

# Subtle amber bar at top of risk section
accent_bar(c, 0, y + 2, PW, 2, HexColor("#8A5A10"))

# Risk cards — 2×2
cw_r = (CW - 24) / 2
ch_r = 125
gap_r = 12

risks = [
    ("01", "TRADE TENSIONS",      "Escalation of tariffs and retaliatory measures could disrupt supply chains and dampen investment across advanced and developing economies.", R_AMB),
    ("02", "FINANCIAL VOLATILITY", "A deterioration in sentiment could tighten financing conditions, especially for EMDEs dependent on external capital flows.", R_AMB),
    ("03", "INVENTORY CORRECTION", "Firms that front-loaded purchases are now drawing down stocks, reducing near-term demand and production signals.", R_GLD),
    ("04", "CLIMATE SHOCKS",      "Extreme weather events continue to threaten agricultural output and infrastructure in vulnerable regions.", R_GLD),
]

rt = y - 50

for i, (num, title, desc, accent) in enumerate(risks):
    cx = ML if i % 2 == 0 else ML + cw_r + 24
    row = i // 2
    cy = rt - row * (ch_r + gap_r) - ch_r

    # Card
    rr(c, cx, cy, cw_r, ch_r, 4, fill=HexColor("#112A44"))

    # Left accent bar inside card
    accent_bar(c, cx + 8, cy + 14, 3, ch_r - 28, accent)

    # Number
    rr(c, cx + 18, cy + ch_r - 28, 26, 18, 3, fill=accent)
    c.setFont("GB", 9); c.setFillColor(R_BG)
    c.drawString(cx + 23, cy + ch_r - 25, num)

    # Title
    c.setFont("IB", 10.5); c.setFillColor(accent)
    c.drawString(cx + 52, cy + ch_r - 26, title)

    # Description
    T(c, desc, cx + 18, cy + ch_r - 46, cw_r - 34, "WR", 8.5, HexColor("#96AAC0"), ld=12)

# Tariff callout
ty = rt - 2 * (ch_r + gap_r) - 55
tcw = CW * 0.68
tcx = ML + (CW - tcw) / 2
rr(c, tcx, ty - 36, tcw, 42, 3, fill=HexColor("#0F2440"), stroke=R_AMB, sw=1)
c.setFont("JM", 9.5); c.setFillColor(R_AMB)
ts = "TARIFF EFFECTS  ·  Escalating trade barriers could reduce global GDP by up to 0.5% in the near term"
T(c, ts, tcx + 16, ty - 16, tcw - 32, "JM", 9.5, R_AMB, ld=13, al='center')

y -= s3_h + 10

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  IV. POLICY ACTIONS FOR SUSTAINED GROWTH
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

s4_h = 270
c.setFillColor(WARM_W)
c.rect(ML - 12, y - s4_h, CW + 24, s4_h + 4, fill=1, stroke=0)

c.setFont("IB", 12.5); c.setFillColor(MID_BLUE)
c.drawString(ML, y - 24, "POLICY ACTIONS FOR SUSTAINED GROWTH")
c.setStrokeColor(TEAL); c.setLineWidth(0.8)
c.line(ML, y - 30, ML + 330, y - 30)

# Table header
thy = y - 46
c.setFont("JL", 8.5); c.setFillColor(COOL_G)
c.drawString(ML, thy, "REFORM AREA")
c.drawString(ML + 150, thy, "GLOBAL ACTION")
c.drawString(ML + 530, thy, "DOMESTIC ACTION")
dv(c, ML, thy - 5, CW, HexColor("#D0D4DA"), 0.3)

pols = [
    ("Trade",     "Improve the multilateral trade environment",       "Diversify trade partners and products"),
    ("Finance",   "Ease external financing constraints for EMDEs",   "Strengthen macroeconomic policy frameworks"),
    ("Climate",   "Scale up climate risk mitigation & adaptation",    "Invest in resilient infrastructure"),
    ("Investment","Catalyze private capital flows",                   "Remove structural bottlenecks to business entry"),
    ("Jobs",      "Support cross-border labor mobility",              "Enhance skills development & labor market flexibility"),
]

rh = 36
for i, (area, ga, da) in enumerate(pols):
    ry = thy - 18 - i * rh
    c.setFillColor(TEAL); c.circle(ML + 4, ry + 3, 2.2, fill=1, stroke=0)
    c.setFont("IB", 9); c.setFillColor(DEEP_TEAL)
    c.drawString(ML + 14, ry, area.upper())
    c.setFont("WR", 8.5); c.setFillColor(TX_DK)
    T(c, ga, ML + 150, ry + 1, 360, "WR", 8.5, TX_DK, ld=11.5)
    T(c, da, ML + 530, ry + 1, 400, "WR", 8.5, TX_DK, ld=11.5)
    if i < 4:
        dv(c, ML + 14, ry - 12, CW - 14, HexColor("#E2E2E2"), 0.2)

y -= s4_h + 10

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  V. WORLD BANK 2030 STRATEGIC PRIORITIES  ★ Visual Centerpiece ★
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

s5_h = 640
c.setFillColor(DARK_BLUE)
c.rect(0, y - s5_h, PW, s5_h + 4, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Subtle diagonal pattern
c.saveState()
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#0E2240")); c.setLineWidth(0.12)

c.restoreState()

    ("1.5B",  "people",  "Health Services",  "Deliver quality, affordable health services",          AMBER, TEAL),
    ("300M",  "people",  "Mission 300",      "Provide electricity access in Sub-Saharan Africa",      AMBER, TEAL),
    ("300M",  "farmers", "AgriConnect",      "Help farmers move up the agricultural value chain",     AMBER, TEAL),

    ("1B+",   "people",  "Water Forward",    "Water security; 400M World Bank Group commitment",     AMBER, TEAL),
]

for i in range(3):

    v, u, t, d, vc, ac = priors[i]

    rr(c, cx, cy, cw3, ch1, 5, fill=CARD)

def W(f, s, t): return pdfmetrics.stringWidth(t, f, s)

def rr(c, x, y, w, h, r, fill=None, stroke=None, sw=0.5):
    p = c.beginPath(); p.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r)
    if fill: c.setFillColor(fill)
    if stroke: c.setStrokeColor(stroke); c.setLineWidth(sw)
    if fill and stroke: c.drawPath(p, 1, 1)
    elif fill: c.drawPath(p, 1, 0)
    elif stroke: c.drawPath(p, 0, 1)

def T(c, t, x, y, mw, f, s, col, ld=None, al='left'):
    """Text block. Returns total height."""
    if not ld: ld = s * 1.48
    c.setFont(f, s); c.setFillColor(col)
    lines = simpleSplit(t, f, s, mw) if mw > 0 else [t]
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        ty = y - i * ld
        if al == 'center':
            c.drawString(x + (mw - W(f, s, ln)) / 2, ty, ln)
        elif al == 'right':
            c.drawString(x + mw - W(f, s, ln), ty, ln)
        else:
            c.drawString(x, ty, ln)
    return len(lines) * ld

def dv(c, x, y, w, col=DIV, sw=0.4):
    c.setStrokeColor(col); c.setLineWidth(sw); c.line(x, y, x + w, y)

def accent_bar(c, x, y, w, h, col):
    c.setFillColor(col); c.rect(x, y, w, h, fill=1, stroke=0)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Economic Prospects Poster — A1 Portrait
Design Philosophy: Measured Force
Refined Pass 2 — Museum-quality craftsmanship
"""

import os
from reportlab.lib.units import mm
from reportlab.lib.colors import HexColor, Color
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont
from reportlab.lib.utils import simpleSplit

# ─── Page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PW = 594 * mm   # 1683.78pt
PH = 841 * mm   # 2383.94pt

# ─── Grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML  = 50 * mm
MR  = 50 * mm
CW  = PW - ML - MR   # content width
COL = 4               # 4-column grid
GUT = 16               # gutter between columns
COL_W = (CW - (COL - 1) * GUT) / COL

# ─── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = HexColor("#0A1C32")
DARK_BLUE  = HexColor("#0E2640")
MID_BLUE   = HexColor("#184880")
INST_BLUE  = HexColor("#1A5CA0")
TEAL       = HexColor("#0B7E8C")
DEEP_TEAL  = HexColor("#076068")
PALE_BLUE  = HexColor("#E1EBF5")
SKY        = HexColor("#D4E4F2")
AMBER      = HexColor("#CC8F1F")
BRIGHT_AMB = HexColor("#D9A42A")
WARM_W     = HexColor("#F4F1E9")
COOL_G     = HexColor("#8A9BAD")
MID_G      = HexColor("#5C6F82")
DARK_G     = HexColor("#3A4A5C")
TX_DK      = HexColor("#182430")
TX_LT      = HexColor("#EEEAE2")
R_BG       = HexColor("#0C1E34")
R_AMB      = HexColor("#D4801E")
R_GLD      = HexColor("#BF9530")
CARD       = HexColor("#12304C")
CARD2      = HexColor("#153858")
DIV        = HexColor("#C0C8D2")

# ─── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
def R(t, f):
    p = os.path.join(FD, f)
    if os.path.exists(p): pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont(t, p))

R("BB","BigShoulders-Bold.ttf");    R("BR","BigShoulders-Regular.ttf")
R("WB","WorkSans-Bold.ttf");       R("WR","WorkSans-Regular.ttf")
R("WI","WorkSans-Italic.ttf");     R("WBI","WorkSans-BoldItalic.ttf")
R("GB","GeistMono-Bold.ttf");      R("GR","GeistMono-Regular.ttf")
R("JL","Jura-Light.ttf");          R("JM","Jura-Medium.ttf")
R("SR","IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf"); R("SB","IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf")
R("IB","InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf");  R("IR","InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf")
R("CB","CrimsonPro-Bold.ttf");      R("CR","CrimsonPro-Regular.ttf")
R("CI","CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf")
R("OB","Outfit-Bold.ttf");          R("OR","Outfit-Regular.ttf")
R("JB","JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf");   R("JR","JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf")

# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def W(f, s, t): return pdfmetrics.stringWidth(t, f, s)

def rr(c, x, y, w, h, r, fill=None, stroke=None, sw=0.5):
    p = c.beginPath(); p.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r)
    if fill: c.setFillColor(fill)
    if stroke: c.setStrokeColor(stroke); c.setLineWidth(sw)
    if fill and stroke: c.drawPath(p, 1, 1)
    elif fill: c.drawPath(p, 1, 0)
    elif stroke: c.drawPath(p, 0, 1)

def T(c, t, x, y, mw, f, s, col, ld=None, al='left'):
    """Text block. Returns total height."""
    if not ld: ld = s * 1.48
    c.setFont(f, s); c.setFillColor(col)
    lines = simpleSplit(t, f, s, mw) if mw > 0 else [t]
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        ty = y - i * ld
        if al == 'center':
            c.drawString(x + (mw - W(f, s, ln)) / 2, ty, ln)
        elif al == 'right':
            c.drawString(x + mw - W(f, s, ln), ty, ln)
        else:
            c.drawString(x, ty, ln)
    return len(lines) * ld

def dv(c, x, y, w, col=DIV, sw=0.4):
    c.setStrokeColor(col); c.setLineWidth(sw); c.line(x, y, x + w, y)

def accent_bar(c, x, y, w, h, col):
    c.setFillColor(col); c.rect(x, y, w, h, fill=1, stroke=0)

# ─── Canvas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
c = canvas.Canvas("/app/output/final_poster.pdf", pagesize=(PW, PH))
y = PH - 34 * mm   # top cursor

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  I. TITLE BAND
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Subtle vertical grid lines in title area
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#0F2438")); c.setLineWidth(0.25)
for vx in range(int(ML), int(PW - MR), 80):
    c.line(vx, y - tb_h + 6, vx, y + 34 * mm - 6)

# Amber accent bar — left edge
accent_bar(c, ML, y - tb_h + 12, 3, 28, AMBER)

# Title
c.setFont("BB", 48); c.setFillColor(TX_LT)
c.drawString(ML + 14, y - 52, "GLOBAL ECONOMIC PROSPECTS")

# Subtitle
c.setFont("WR", 17); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(ML + 14, y - 80, "Resilience Amid Uncertainty")

# Rule
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#8A6A1A")); c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(ML + 14, y - 90, ML + 380, y - 90)

# Summary
c.setFont("WR", 10); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#8CA0B4"))
T(c, "The global economy has recovered strongly from the 2020 recession, but vulnerable "
   "economies lag behind as trade tensions and policy uncertainty cloud the outlook.",
   ML + 14, y - 110, CW - 280, "WR", 10, HexColor("#8CA0B4"), ld=14)

# Right meta
c.setFont("JM", 10.5); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#6A8298"))
c.drawRightString(PW - MR, y - 48, "WORLD BANK GROUP")
c.setFont("JL", 9); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#506878"))
c.drawRightString(PW - MR, y - 64, "Global Economic Prospects  ·  June 2025")

y -= tb_h + 6

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  II. A HISTORIC RECOVERY — BUT UNEVEN
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

s2_h = 355
c.setFillColor(PALE_BLUE)
c.rect(ML - 12, y - s2_h, CW + 24, s2_h + 4, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Section header
c.setFont("IB", 12.5); c.setFillColor(MID_BLUE)
c.drawString(ML, y - 24, "A HISTORIC RECOVERY — BUT UNEVEN")
c.setStrokeColor(TEAL); c.setLineWidth(0.8)
c.line(ML, y - 30, ML + 310, y - 30)

# ── Left hero: "6 DECADES" ──
hy = y - 88
c.setFont("GB", 80); c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.drawString(ML, hy, "6")
six_w = W("GB", 80, "6")
c.setFont("GB", 26); c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.drawString(ML + six_w + 8, hy + 14, "DECADES")

c.setFont("JL", 11); c.setFillColor(DARK_G)
c.drawString(ML, hy - 22, "Strongest recovery from the 2020 recession")

accent_bar(c, ML, hy - 38, 80, 2, AMBER)

# ── Right hero: "1.2 BILLION" ──
m2x = ML + 440
c.setFont("GB", 80); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(m2x, hy, "1.2")
w12 = W("GB", 80, "1.2")
c.setFont("GB", 24); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(m2x + w12 + 8, hy + 12, "BILLION")

c.setFont("JL", 11); c.setFillColor(DARK_G)
c.drawString(m2x, hy - 22, "Youth entering working age in the next decade")

accent_bar(c, m2x, hy - 38, 80, 2, TEAL)

# ── Body ──
by = hy - 62
c.setFont("WR", 9.5); c.setFillColor(TX_DK)
b1 = ("The global economy has demonstrated notable resilience in the face of heightened trade tensions "
      "and policy uncertainty. Last year's faster-than-expected growth capped a recovery from the 2020 "
      "recession that is unmatched in six decades. However, this headline resilience masks a widening gap: "
      "vulnerable emerging market and developing economies (EMDEs) continue to lag significantly behind "
      "advanced economies and more robust peers.")
h1 = T(c, b1, ML, by, CW, "WR", 9.5, TX_DK, ld=13.5)

b2 = ("In the current year, global growth is projected to edge downward, driven in part by firms scaling "

      "trade tensions escalate or financial market sentiment deteriorates sharply.")
T(c, b2, ML, by - h1 - 6, CW, "WR", 9.5, TX_DK, ld=13.5)

y -= s2_h + 10

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  III. RISKS TO THE OUTLOOK
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Subtle horizontal grid

for gy in range(int(y - s3_h), int(y + 4), 48):

accent_bar(c, 0, y + 2, PW, 2, HexColor("#8A5A10"))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Economic Prospects Poster — A1 Portrait
Design Philosophy: Measured Force
Refined Pass 2 — Museum-quality craftsmanship
"""

import os
from reportlab.lib.units import mm
from reportlab.lib.colors import HexColor, Color
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont
from reportlab.lib.utils import simpleSplit

# ─── Page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PW = 594 * mm   # 1683.78pt
PH = 841 * mm   # 2383.94pt

# ─── Grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML  = 50 * mm
MR  = 50 * mm
CW  = PW - ML - MR   # content width
COL = 4               # 4-column grid
GUT = 16               # gutter between columns
COL_W = (CW - (COL - 1) * GUT) / COL

# ─── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = HexColor("#0A1C32")
DARK_BLUE  = HexColor("#0E2640")
MID_BLUE   = HexColor("#184880")
INST_BLUE  = HexColor("#1A5CA0")
TEAL       = HexColor("#0B7E8C")
DEEP_TEAL  = HexColor("#076068")
PALE_BLUE  = HexColor("#E1EBF5")
SKY        = HexColor("#D4E4F2")
AMBER      = HexColor("#CC8F1F")
BRIGHT_AMB = HexColor("#D9A42A")
WARM_W     = HexColor("#F4F1E9")
COOL_G     = HexColor("#8A9BAD")
MID_G      = HexColor("#5C6F82")
DARK_G     = HexColor("#3A4A5C")
TX_DK      = HexColor("#182430")
TX_LT      = HexColor("#EEEAE2")
R_BG       = HexColor("#0C1E34")
R_AMB      = HexColor("#D4801E")
R_GLD      = HexColor("#BF9530")
CARD       = HexColor("#12304C")
CARD2      = HexColor("#153858")
DIV        = HexColor("#C0C8D2")

# ─── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
def R(t, f):
    p = os.path.join(FD, f)
    if os.path.exists(p): pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont(t, p))

R("BB","BigShoulders-Bold.ttf");    R("BR","BigShoulders-Regular.ttf")
R("WB","WorkSans-Bold.ttf");       R("WR","WorkSans-Regular.ttf")
R("WI","WorkSans-Italic.ttf");     R("WBI","WorkSans-BoldItalic.ttf")
R("GB","GeistMono-Bold.ttf");      R("GR","GeistMono-Regular.ttf")
R("JL","Jura-Light.ttf");          R("JM","Jura-Medium.ttf")
R("SR","IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf"); R("SB","IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf")
R("IB","InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf");  R("IR","InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf")
R("CB","CrimsonPro-Bold.ttf");      R("CR","CrimsonPro-Regular.ttf")
R("CI","CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf")
R("OB","Outfit-Bold.ttf");          R("OR","Outfit-Regular.ttf")
R("JB","JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf");   R("JR","JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf")

# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def W(f, s, t): return pdfmetrics.stringWidth(t, f, s)

def rr(c, x, y, w, h, r, fill=None, stroke=None, sw=0.5):
    p = c.beginPath(); p.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r)
    if fill: c.setFillColor(fill)
    if stroke: c.setStrokeColor(stroke); c.setLineWidth(sw)
    if fill and stroke: c.drawPath(p, 1, 1)
    elif fill: c.drawPath(p, 1, 0)
    elif stroke: c.drawPath(p, 0, 1)

def T(c, t, x, y, mw, f, s, col, ld=None, al='left'):
    """Text block. Returns total height."""
    if not ld: ld = s * 1.48
    c.setFont(f, s); c.setFillColor(col)
    lines = simpleSplit(t, f, s, mw) if mw > 0 else [t]
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        ty = y - i * ld
        if al == 'center':
            c.drawString(x + (mw - W(f, s, ln)) / 2, ty, ln)
        elif al == 'right':
            c.drawString(x + mw - W(f, s, ln), ty, ln)
        else:
            c.drawString(x, ty, ln)
    return len(lines) * ld

def dv(c, x, y, w, col=DIV, sw=0.4):
    c.setStrokeColor(col); c.setLineWidth(sw); c.line(x, y, x + w, y)

def accent_bar(c, x, y, w, h, col):
    c.setFillColor(col); c.rect(x, y, w, h, fill=1, stroke=0)

# ─── Canvas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
c = canvas.Canvas("/app/output/final_poster.pdf", pagesize=(PW, PH))
y = PH - 34 * mm   # top cursor

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  I. TITLE BAND
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tb_h = 210
c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.rect(0, y - tb_h, PW, tb_h + 34 * mm, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Subtle vertical grid lines in title area
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#0F2438")); c.setLineWidth(0.25)
for vx in range(int(ML), int(PW - MR), 80):
    c.line(vx, y - tb_h + 6, vx, y + 34 * mm - 6)

# Amber accent bar — left edge
accent_bar(c, ML, y - tb_h + 12, 3, 28, AMBER)

# Title
c.setFont("BB", 48); c.setFillColor(TX_LT)
c.drawString(ML + 14, y - 52, "GLOBAL ECONOMIC PROSPECTS")

# Subtitle
c.setFont("WR", 17); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(ML + 14, y - 80, "Resilience Amid Uncertainty")

# Rule
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#8A6A1A")); c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(ML + 14, y - 90, ML + 380, y - 90)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Economic Prospects Poster — A1 Portrait
Design Philosophy: Measured Force
Pass 3 — Final museum-quality refinement
"""

import os, math
from reportlab.lib.units import mm
from reportlab.lib.colors import HexColor, Color
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont
from reportlab.lib.utils import simpleSplit

# ─── Dimensions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PW = 594 * mm
PH = 841 * mm

# ─── Grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML = 48 * mm
MR = 48 * mm
CW = PW - ML - MR

# ─── Palette — calibrated institutional ───────────────────────────────────────
NAVY      = HexColor("#091B30")
DBLUE     = HexColor("#0D2440")
MBLUE     = HexColor("#17467E")
IBLUE     = HexColor("#1B5A9C")
TEAL      = HexColor("#0A7D8A")
DTEAL     = HexColor("#065D65")
PBLUE     = HexColor("#DFE9F4")
SKY       = HexColor("#D0E1EF")
AMBER     = HexColor("#C98B1A")
BAMBER    = HexColor("#D9A226")
WW        = HexColor("#F3F0E7")
CG        = HexColor("#8898AA")
MG        = HexColor("#5A6D80")
DG        = HexColor("#384A5C")
TDK       = HexColor("#16212E")
TLT       = HexColor("#ECE8DF")
RBG       = HexColor("#0B1D33")
RAMB      = HexColor("#D07A18")
RGLD      = HexColor("#BA8F28")
CRD       = HexColor("#102E4A")
CRD2      = HexColor("#143658")
DIV       = HexColor("#BCC4CE")

# ─── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
def R(t,f):
    p=os.path.join(FD,f)
    if os.path.exists(p): pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont(t,p))

R("BB","BigShoulders-Bold.ttf");    R("BR","BigShoulders-Regular.ttf")
R("WB","WorkSans-Bold.ttf");       R("WR","WorkSans-Regular.ttf")
R("WI","WorkSans-Italic.ttf");     R("WBI","WorkSans-BoldItalic.ttf")
R("GB","GeistMono-Bold.ttf");      R("GR","GeistMono-Regular.ttf")
R("JL","Jura-Light.ttf");          R("JM","Jura-Medium.ttf")
R("SB","IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf");   R("SR","IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf")
R("IB","InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf"); R("IR","InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf")
R("CR","CrimsonPro-Regular.ttf");  R("CB","CrimsonPro-Bold.ttf")
R("OB","Outfit-Bold.ttf");         R("OR","Outfit-Regular.ttf")
R("JB","JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf");  R("JR","JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf")

# ─── Utilities ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def W(f,s,t): return pdfmetrics.stringWidth(t,f,s)

def rr(c,x,y,w,h,r,fill=None,stroke=None,sw=0.5):
    p=c.beginPath(); p.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r)
    if fill: c.setFillColor(fill)
    if stroke: c.setStrokeColor(stroke); c.setLineWidth(sw)
    if fill and stroke: c.drawPath(p,1,1)
    elif fill: c.drawPath(p,1,0)
    elif stroke: c.drawPath(p,0,1)

def T(c,t,x,y,mw,f,s,col,ld=None,al='left'):
    if not ld: ld=s*1.48
    c.setFont(f,s); c.setFillColor(col)
    lines=simpleSplit(t,f,s,mw) if mw>0 else [t]
    for i,ln in enumerate(lines):
        ty=y-i*ld
        if al=='center': c.drawString(x+(mw-W(f,s,ln))/2,ty,ln)
        elif al=='right': c.drawString(x+mw-W(f,s,ln),ty,ln)
        else: c.drawString(x,ty,ln)
    return len(lines)*ld

def dv(c,x,y,w,col=DIV,sw=0.4):
    c.setStrokeColor(col); c.setLineWidth(sw); c.line(x,y,x+w,y)

def bar(c,x,y,w,h,col):
    c.setFillColor(col); c.rect(x,y,w,h,fill=1,stroke=0)

# ─── Canvas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
c = canvas.Canvas("/app/output/final_poster.pdf", pagesize=(PW,PH))
Y = PH - 32*mm  # top cursor

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  I. TITLE BAND
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tb_h = 215
c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.rect(0, Y-tb_h, PW, tb_h+32*mm, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Refined vertical grid — very subtle
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#0E2238")); c.setLineWidth(0.2)
for vx in range(int(ML), int(PW-MR), 76):
    c.line(vx, Y-tb_h+8, vx, Y+32*mm-8)

# Amber accent bar left
bar(c, ML, Y-tb_h+14, 3, 32, AMBER)

# Title — monumental
c.setFont("BB",50); c.setFillColor(TLT)
c.drawString(ML+14, Y-54, "GLOBAL ECONOMIC PROSPECTS")

# Subtitle — warm amber
c.setFont("WR",17); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(ML+14, Y-82, "Resilience Amid Uncertainty")

# Fine rule
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#7A5A12")); c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(ML+14, Y-92, ML+380, Y-92)

# Summary — hushed
c.setFont("WR",10); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#849AB0"))
T(c,"The global economy has recovered strongly from the 2020 recession, but vulnerable "
  "economies lag behind as trade tensions and policy uncertainty cloud the outlook.",
  ML+14, Y-112, CW-260, "WR",10, HexColor("#849AB0"), ld=14)

# Right-aligned meta — institutional
c.setFont("JM",10); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#5E7A92"))
c.drawRightString(PW-MR, Y-46, "WORLD BANK GROUP")
c.setFont("JL",9); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#466278"))
c.drawRightString(PW-MR, Y-62, "Global Economic Prospects  ·  June 2025")

Y -= tb_h + 6

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  II. A HISTORIC RECOVERY — BUT UNEVEN
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

s2h = 350
c.setFillColor(PBLUE)
c.rect(ML-14, Y-s2h, CW+28, s2h+4, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Header
c.setFont("IB",12); c.setFillColor(MBLUE)
c.drawString(ML, Y-24, "A HISTORIC RECOVERY — BUT UNEVEN")
c.setStrokeColor(TEAL); c.setLineWidth(0.8)
c.line(ML, Y-30, ML+300, Y-30)

# ── Hero left: "6 DECADES" ──
hy = Y-90
c.setFont("GB",84); c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.drawString(ML, hy, "6")
sw6 = W("GB",84,"6")
c.setFont("GB",26); c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.drawString(ML+sw6+10, hy+16, "DECADES")
c.setFont("JL",11); c.setFillColor(DG)
c.drawString(ML, hy-24, "Strongest recovery from the 2020 recession")
bar(c, ML, hy-40, 74, 2.2, AMBER)

# ── Hero right: "1.2 BILLION" ──
m2x = ML+430
c.setFont("GB",84); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(m2x, hy, "1.2")
sw12 = W("GB",84,"1.2")
c.setFont("GB",24); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(m2x+sw12+10, hy+14, "BILLION")
c.setFont("JL",11); c.setFillColor(DG)
c.drawString(m2x, hy-24, "Youth entering working age in the next decade")
bar(c, m2x, hy-40, 74, 2.2, TEAL)

# ── Body ──
by = hy-64
c.setFont("WR",9.5); c.setFillColor(TDK)
b1=("The global economy has demonstrated notable resilience in the face of heightened trade tensions "
    "and policy uncertainty. Last year's faster-than-expected growth capped a recovery from the 2020 "
    "recession that is unmatched in six decades. However, this headline resilience masks a widening gap: "
    "vulnerable emerging market and developing economies (EMDEs) continue to lag significantly behind "
    "advanced economies and more robust peers.")
h1=T(c,b1,ML,by,CW,"WR",9.5,TDK,ld=13.5)

b2=("In the current year, global growth is projected to edge downward, driven in part by firms scaling "
    "back inventory accumulation and the intensifying effects of tariffs. Growth could falter further if "
    "trade tensions escalate or financial market sentiment deteriorates sharply.")
T(c,b2,ML,by-h1-6,CW,"WR",9.5,TDK,ld=13.5)

Y -= s2h + 8

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  III. RISKS TO THE OUTLOOK — Strong visual weight
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

s3h = 430
c.setFillColor(RBG)
c.rect(0, Y-s3h, PW, s3h+4, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Subtle horizontal grid
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#0F2640")); c.setLineWidth(0.12)
for gy in range(int(Y-s3h), int(Y+4), 44):
    c.line(0,gy,PW,gy)

# Top amber bar — warning
bar(c, 0, Y+1, PW, 2, HexColor("#7A5210"))

# Header
c.setFont("IB",12); c.setFillColor(RAMB)
c.drawString(ML, Y-24, "RISKS TO THE OUTLOOK")
c.setStrokeColor(RAMB); c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(ML, Y-31, ML+210, Y-31)

# Risk cards — 2×2
cw_r = (CW-20)/2
ch_r = 130
gap_r = 14

risks=[
    ("01","TRADE TENSIONS","Escalation of tariffs and retaliatory measures could disrupt supply chains and dampen investment across advanced and developing economies.",RAMB),
    ("02","FINANCIAL VOLATILITY","A deterioration in sentiment could tighten financing conditions, especially for EMDEs dependent on external capital flows.",RAMB),
    ("03","INVENTORY CORRECTION","Firms that front-loaded purchases are now drawing down stocks, reducing near-term demand and production signals.",RGLD),
    ("04","CLIMATE SHOCKS","Extreme weather events continue to threaten agricultural output and infrastructure in vulnerable regions.",RGLD),
]

rt = Y-52

for i,(num,title,desc,accent) in enumerate(risks):
    cx = ML if i%2==0 else ML+cw_r+20
    row = i//2
    cy = rt - row*(ch_r+gap_r) - ch_r

    rr(c,cx,cy,cw_r,ch_r,4,fill=HexColor("#0F2842"))

    # Left accent bar
    bar(c, cx+8, cy+16, 2.5, ch_r-32, accent)

    # Number badge
    rr(c, cx+18, cy+ch_r-28, 26,18,3, fill=accent)
    c.setFont("GB",9); c.setFillColor(RBG)
    c.drawString(cx+23, cy+ch_r-25, num)

    # Title
    c.setFont("IB",10.5); c.setFillColor(accent)
    c.drawString(cx+52, cy+ch_r-25, title)

    # Desc
    T(c,desc, cx+18, cy+ch_r-46, cw_r-34, "WR",8.5, HexColor("#8EA4BC"), ld=12)

# Tariff callout
ty = rt - 2*(ch_r+gap_r) - 60
tcw = CW*0.66
tcx = ML + (CW-tcw)/2
rr(c,tcx,ty-38,tcw,44,3,fill=HexColor("#0D2238"),stroke=RAMB,sw=1)
c.setFont("JM",9.5); c.setFillColor(RAMB)
ts="TARIFF EFFECTS  ·  Escalating trade barriers could reduce global GDP by up to 0.5% in the near term"
T(c,ts,tcx+18,ty-17,tcw-36,"JM",9.5,RAMB,ld=13,al='center')

Y -= s3h + 8

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  IV. POLICY ACTIONS FOR SUSTAINED GROWTH
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

s4h = 275
c.setFillColor(WW)
c.rect(ML-14, Y-s4h, CW+28, s4h+4, fill=1, stroke=0)

c.setFont("IB",12); c.setFillColor(MBLUE)
c.drawString(ML, Y-24, "POLICY ACTIONS FOR SUSTAINED GROWTH")
c.setStrokeColor(TEAL); c.setLineWidth(0.8)
c.line(ML, Y-30, ML+320, Y-30)

# Table
thy = Y-46
c.setFont("JL",8.5); c.setFillColor(CG)
c.drawString(ML,thy,"REFORM AREA")
c.drawString(ML+145,thy,"GLOBAL ACTION")
c.drawString(ML+520,thy,"DOMESTIC ACTION")
dv(c,ML,thy-5,CW,HexColor("#C8CCD2"),0.3)

pols=[
    ("Trade",    "Improve the multilateral trade environment",      "Diversify trade partners and products"),
    ("Finance",  "Ease external financing constraints for EMDEs",  "Strengthen macroeconomic policy frameworks"),

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Economic Prospects Poster — A1 Portrait
Design Philosophy: Measured Force
Pass 3 — Final museum-quality refinement
"""

import os, math
from reportlab.lib.units import mm
from reportlab.lib.colors import HexColor, Color
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont
from reportlab.lib.utils import simpleSplit

# ─── Dimensions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PW = 594 * mm
PH = 841 * mm

# ─── Grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML = 48 * mm
MR = 48 * mm
CW = PW - ML - MR

# ─── Palette — calibrated institutional ───────────────────────────────────────
NAVY      = HexColor("#091B30")
DBLUE     = HexColor("#0D2440")
MBLUE     = HexColor("#17467E")
IBLUE     = HexColor("#1B5A9C")
TEAL      = HexColor("#0A7D8A")
DTEAL     = HexColor("#065D65")
PBLUE     = HexColor("#DFE9F4")
SKY       = HexColor("#D0E1EF")
AMBER     = HexColor("#C98B1A")
BAMBER    = HexColor("#D9A226")
WW        = HexColor("#F3F0E7")
CG        = HexColor("#8898AA")
MG        = HexColor("#5A6D80")
DG        = HexColor("#384A5C")
TDK       = HexColor("#16212E")
TLT       = HexColor("#ECE8DF")
RBG       = HexColor("#0B1D33")
RAMB      = HexColor("#D07A18")
RGLD      = HexColor("#BA8F28")
CRD       = HexColor("#102E4A")
CRD2      = HexColor("#143658")
DIV       = HexColor("#BCC4CE")

# ─── Fonts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
def R(t,f):
    p=os.path.join(FD,f)
    if os.path.exists(p): pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont(t,p))

R("BB","BigShoulders-Bold.ttf");    R("BR","BigShoulders-Regular.ttf")
R("WB","WorkSans-Bold.ttf");       R("WR","WorkSans-Regular.ttf")
R("WI","WorkSans-Italic.ttf");     R("WBI","WorkSans-BoldItalic.ttf")
R("GB","GeistMono-Bold.ttf");      R("GR","GeistMono-Regular.ttf")
R("JL","Jura-Light.ttf");          R("JM","Jura-Medium.ttf")
R("SB","IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf");   R("SR","IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf")
R("IB","InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf"); R("IR","InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf")
R("CR","CrimsonPro-Regular.ttf");  R("CB","CrimsonPro-Bold.ttf")
R("OB","Outfit-Bold.ttf");         R("OR","Outfit-Regular.ttf")
R("JB","JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf");  R("JR","JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf")

# ─── Utilities ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def W(f,s,t): return pdfmetrics.stringWidth(t,f,s)

def rr(c,x,y,w,h,r,fill=None,stroke=None,sw=0.5):
    p=c.beginPath(); p.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r)
    if fill: c.setFillColor(fill)
    if stroke: c.setStrokeColor(stroke); c.setLineWidth(sw)
    if fill and stroke: c.drawPath(p,1,1)
    elif fill: c.drawPath(p,1,0)
    elif stroke: c.drawPath(p,0,1)

def T(c,t,x,y,mw,f,s,col,ld=None,al='left'):
    if not ld: ld=s*1.48
    c.setFont(f,s); c.setFillColor(col)
    lines=simpleSplit(t,f,s,mw) if mw>0 else [t]
    for i,ln in enumerate(lines):
        ty=y-i*ld
        if al=='center': c.drawString(x+(mw-W(f,s,ln))/2,ty,ln)
        elif al=='right': c.drawString(x+mw-W(f,s,ln),ty,ln)
        else: c.drawString(x,ty,ln)
    return len(lines)*ld

def dv(c,x,y,w,col=DIV,sw=0.4):
    c.setStrokeColor(col); c.setLineWidth(sw); c.line(x,y,x+w,y)

def bar(c,x,y,w,h,col):
    c.setFillColor(col); c.rect(x,y,w,h,fill=1,stroke=0)

# ─── Canvas ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
c = canvas.Canvas("/app/output/final_poster.pdf", pagesize=(PW,PH))
Y = PH - 32*mm  # top cursor

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  I. TITLE BAND
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tb_h = 215
c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.rect(0, Y-tb_h, PW, tb_h+32*mm, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Refined vertical grid — very subtle
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#0E2238")); c.setLineWidth(0.2)
for vx in range(int(ML), int(PW-MR), 76):
    c.line(vx, Y-tb_h+8, vx, Y+32*mm-8)

# Amber accent bar left
bar(c, ML, Y-tb_h+14, 3, 32, AMBER)

# Title — monumental
c.setFont("BB",50); c.setFillColor(TLT)
c.drawString(ML+14, Y-54, "GLOBAL ECONOMIC PROSPECTS")

# Subtitle — warm amber
c.setFont("WR",17); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(ML+14, Y-82, "Resilience Amid Uncertainty")

# Fine rule
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#7A5A12")); c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(ML+14, Y-92, ML+380, Y-92)

# Summary — hushed
c.setFont("WR",10); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#849AB0"))
T(c,"The global economy has recovered strongly from the 2020 recession, but vulnerable "
  "economies lag behind as trade tensions and policy uncertainty cloud the outlook.",
  ML+14, Y-112, CW-260, "WR",10, HexColor("#849AB0"), ld=14)

# Right-aligned meta — institutional
c.setFont("JM",10); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#5E7A92"))
c.drawRightString(PW-MR, Y-46, "WORLD BANK GROUP")
c.setFont("JL",9); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#466278"))
c.drawRightString(PW-MR, Y-62, "Global Economic Prospects  ·  June 2025")

Y -= tb_h + 6

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  II. A HISTORIC RECOVERY — BUT UNEVEN
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

s2h = 350
c.setFillColor(PBLUE)
c.rect(ML-14, Y-s2h, CW+28, s2h+4, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Header
c.setFont("IB",12); c.setFillColor(MBLUE)
c.drawString(ML, Y-24, "A HISTORIC RECOVERY — BUT UNEVEN")
c.setStrokeColor(TEAL); c.setLineWidth(0.8)
c.line(ML, Y-30, ML+300, Y-30)

# ── Hero left: "6 DECADES" ──
hy = Y-90
c.setFont("GB",84); c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.drawString(ML, hy, "6")
sw6 = W("GB",84,"6")
c.setFont("GB",26); c.setFillColor(NAVY)
c.drawString(ML+sw6+10, hy+16, "DECADES")
c.setFont("JL",11); c.setFillColor(DG)
c.drawString(ML, hy-24, "Strongest recovery from the 2020 recession")
bar(c, ML, hy-40, 74, 2.2, AMBER)

# ── Hero right: "1.2 BILLION" ──
m2x = ML+430
c.setFont("GB",84); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(m2x, hy, "1.2")
sw12 = W("GB",84,"1.2")
c.setFont("GB",24); c.setFillColor(AMBER)
c.drawString(m2x+sw12+10, hy+14, "BILLION")
c.setFont("JL",11); c.setFillColor(DG)
c.drawString(m2x, hy-24, "Youth entering working age in the next decade")
bar(c, m2x, hy-40, 74, 2.2, TEAL)

# ── Body ──
by = hy-64
c.setFont("WR",9.5); c.setFillColor(TDK)
b1=("The global economy has demonstrated notable resilience in the face of heightened trade tensions "
    "and policy uncertainty. Last year's faster-than-expected growth capped a recovery from the 2020 "
    "recession that is unmatched in six decades. However, this headline resilience masks a widening gap: "
    "vulnerable emerging market and developing economies (EMDEs) continue to lag significantly behind "
    "advanced economies and more robust peers.")
h1=T(c,b1,ML,by,CW,"WR",9.5,TDK,ld=13.5)

b2=("In the current year, global growth is projected to edge downward, driven in part by firms scaling "
    "back inventory accumulation and the intensifying effects of tariffs. Growth could falter further if "
    "trade tensions escalate or financial market sentiment deteriorates sharply.")
T(c,b2,ML,by-h1-6,CW,"WR",9.5,TDK,ld=13.5)

Y -= s2h + 8

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  III. RISKS TO THE OUTLOOK — Strong visual weight
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

s3h = 430
c.setFillColor(RBG)
c.rect(0, Y-s3h, PW, s3h+4, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Subtle horizontal grid
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#0F2640")); c.setLineWidth(0.12)
for gy in range(int(Y-s3h), int(Y+4), 44):
    c.line(0,gy,PW,gy)

# Top amber bar — warning
bar(c, 0, Y+1, PW, 2, HexColor("#7A5210"))

# Header
c.setFont("IB",12); c.setFillColor(RAMB)
c.drawString(ML, Y-24, "RISKS TO THE OUTLOOK")
c.setStrokeColor(RAMB); c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(ML, Y-31, ML+210, Y-31)

# Risk cards — 2×2
cw_r = (CW-20)/2
ch_r = 130
gap_r = 14

risks=[
    ("01","TRADE TENSIONS","Escalation of tariffs and retaliatory measures could disrupt supply chains and dampen investment across advanced and developing economies.",RAMB),
    ("02","FINANCIAL VOLATILITY","A deterioration in sentiment could tighten financing conditions, especially for EMDEs dependent on external capital flows.",RAMB),
    ("03","INVENTORY CORRECTION","Firms that front-loaded purchases are now drawing down stocks, reducing near-term demand and production signals.",RGLD),
    ("04","CLIMATE SHOCKS","Extreme weather events continue to threaten agricultural output and infrastructure in vulnerable regions.",RGLD),
]

rt = Y-52

for i,(num,title,desc,accent) in enumerate(risks):
    cx = ML if i%2==0 else ML+cw_r+20
    row = i//2
    cy = rt - row*(ch_r+gap_r) - ch_r

    rr(c,cx,cy,cw_r,ch_r,4,fill=HexColor("#0F2842"))

    # Left accent bar
    bar(c, cx+8, cy+16, 2.5, ch_r-32, accent)

    # Number badge
    rr(c, cx+18, cy+ch_r-28, 26,18,3, fill=accent)
    c.setFont("GB",9); c.setFillColor(RBG)
    c.drawString(cx+23, cy+ch_r-25, num)

    # Title
    c.setFont("IB",10.5); c.setFillColor(accent)
    c.drawString(cx+52, cy+ch_r-25, title)

    # Desc
    T(c,desc, cx+18, cy+ch_r-46, cw_r-34, "WR",8.5, HexColor("#8EA4BC"), ld=12)

# Tariff callout
ty = rt - 2*(ch_r+gap_r) - 60
tcw = CW*0.66
tcx = ML + (CW-tcw)/2
rr(c,tcx,ty-38,tcw,44,3,fill=HexColor("#0D2238"),stroke=RAMB,sw=1)
c.setFont("JM",9.5); c.setFillColor(RAMB)
ts="TARIFF EFFECTS  ·  Escalating trade barriers could reduce global GDP by up to 0.5% in the near term"
T(c,ts,tcx+18,ty-17,tcw-36,"JM",9.5,RAMB,ld=13,al='center')

Y -= s3h + 8

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  IV. POLICY ACTIONS FOR SUSTAINED GROWTH
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

s4h = 275
c.setFillColor(WW)
c.rect(ML-14, Y-s4h, CW+28, s4h+4, fill=1, stroke=0)

c.setFont("IB",12); c.setFillColor(MBLUE)
c.drawString(ML, Y-24, "POLICY ACTIONS FOR SUSTAINED GROWTH")
c.setStrokeColor(TEAL); c.setLineWidth(0.8)
c.line(ML, Y-30, ML+320, Y-30)

# Table
thy = Y-46
c.setFont("JL",8.5); c.setFillColor(CG)
c.drawString(ML,thy,"REFORM AREA")
c.drawString(ML+145,thy,"GLOBAL ACTION")
c.drawString(ML+520,thy,"DOMESTIC ACTION")
dv(c,ML,thy-5,CW,HexColor("#C8CCD2"),0.3)

pols=[
    ("Trade",    "Improve the multilateral trade environment",      "Diversify trade partners and products"),
    ("Finance",  "Ease external financing constraints for EMDEs",  "Strengthen macroeconomic policy frameworks"),
    ("Climate",  "Scale up climate risk mitigation & adaptation",   "Invest in resilient infrastructure"),
    ("Investment","Catalyze private capital flows",                 "Remove structural bottlenecks to business entry"),
    ("Jobs",     "Support cross-border labor mobility",             "Enhance skills development & labor market flexibility"),
]

rh=38
for i,(area,ga,da) in enumerate(pols):
    ry = thy-18 - i*rh
    c.setFillColor(TEAL); c.circle(ML+4, ry+3, 2.2, fill=1, stroke=0)
    c.setFont("IB",9); c.setFillColor(DTEAL)
    c.drawString(ML+14, ry, area.upper())
    c.setFont("WR",8.5); c.setFillColor(TDK)
    T(c,ga,ML+145,ry+1,358,"WR",8.5,TDK,ld=11.5)
    T(c,da,ML+520,ry+1,380,"WR",8.5,TDK,ld=11.5)
    if i<4: dv(c,ML+14,ry-12,CW-14,HexColor("#DDE0E4"),0.2)

Y -= s4h + 8

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  V. WORLD BANK 2030 STRATEGIC PRIORITIES — ★ Visual Centerpiece ★
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

s5h = 660
c.setFillColor(DBLUE)
c.rect(0, Y-s5h, PW, s5h+4, fill=1, stroke=0)

# Diagonal pattern
c.saveState()
c.setStrokeColor(HexColor("#0C2040")); c.setLineWidth(0.1)
for dx in range(-int(PH), int(PW+PH), 96):
    c.line(dx, Y-s5h, dx+s5h, Y)
c.restoreState()

# Header
c.setFont("IB",12); c.setFillColor(TLT)
c.drawString(ML, Y-24, "WORLD BANK 2030 STRATEGIC PRIORITIES")
c.setStrokeColor(AMBER); c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(ML, Y-31, ML+330, Y-31)

c.setFont("JL",10.5); c.setFillColor(HexColor("#6888A4"))
c.drawString(ML, Y-46, "Flagship initiatives driving inclusive growth and job creation")

# ── Row 1: 3 metric cards ──
cg=14
cw3=(CW-2*cg)/3
ch1=228

priors=[
    ("1.5B","people","Health Services","Deliver quality, affordable health services",AMBER,TEAL),
    ("300M","people","Mission 300","Provide electricity access in Sub-Saharan Africa",AMBER,TEAL),
    ("300M","farmers","AgriConnect","Help farmers move up the agricultural value chain",AMBER,TEAL),
    ("80M","women","Capital Support","Women & women-led businesses access to capital",AMBER,TEAL),

    rr(c,cx,cy,cw3,40,0,fill=HexColor("#0C2640"))

    c.setFillColor(AMBER); c.circle(cx+24, cy+16, 2, fill=1, stroke=0)

# ── Row 2: 2 wider cards ──
cw2=(CW-cg)/2
ch2=195
r2y=r1y-ch1-16

for i in range(2):
    cx=ML+i*(cw2+cg)
    cy=r2y-ch2
    v,u,t,d,vc,ac=priors[3+i]

c.line(ML, Y-30, ML+340, Y-30)

themes=[
    ("Fiscal Policy","Fiscal rules (Jan 2026)\nSmall states (Jun 2024)"),
    ("Trade & Supply","High trade costs (Jun 2021)\nCOVID-19 value chains (Jun 2020)"),
    ("Commodity Markets","Price cycles (Jan 2022)\nEnergy implications (Jun 2022)"),
    ("Financial Spillovers","Rising U.S. rates (Jun 2023)\nRapid debt buildup (Jan 2020)"),
    ("Pandemic Economics","Income inequality (Jan 2022)\nRegional macro (Jun 2020)"),
]

tw5=(CW-4*16)/5
ty=Y-48

for i,(title,exs) in enumerate(themes):
    tx=ML+i*(tw5+16)
    c.setFillColor(TEAL); c.circle(tx+4,ty+3,2.2,fill=1,stroke=0)

Y -= s6h + 6
